status_label: BNPB preliminary update — verification and validation continue

source.title: Official press conference: Update on conditions and response following the M7.7 Nagekeo earthquake

displacement.location: Affected areas in East Nusa Tenggara

confirmed: 14 deaths: 3 in Sikka, 6 in Manggarai and 5 in East Manggarai.
13 injured people: 2 seriously injured and 11 with minor injuries.
Approximately 2,000 people undertook evacuation or self-evacuation.
Approximately 5 households were reported affected; field verification continues.
damage_reports: 54 houses heavily damaged, 9 moderately damaged and 11 slightly damaged.
5 health facilities and 1 education facility damaged in Manggarai Regency.
1 Bulog warehouse, 3 places of worship and 6 government offices affected.
Traffic disruption and electricity outages continued in Nagekeo at the reporting cut-off.
information_gaps: Consolidated missing-person and affected-population figures by district.
Names, damage severity and operational status of the 5 affected health facilities.
Verified WASH, electricity and telecommunications status by district.
Post-disaster disease surveillance and public-health event data.
disclaimer: All figures remain preliminary and may change following further verification and validation by BNPB, BPBD and relevant authorities.
